resources.string: A Watch Face Format take on the Pixel Concentric face — a rotating minute ring, configurable colour palettes, and five complication slots. Install it on your Wear OS watch straight from your phone: some phones can\'t offer standalone watch faces in the Play Store, so this companion sends the install to your watch for you.
Tap \"Install on watch\" to open the Play Store on your paired Wear OS watch. If your watch isn\'t connected, you\'ll be prompted to open it manually.
Opening the Play Store on your watch…
Check your watch to finish installing.
Couldn\'t reach a watch. Make sure one is paired and connected.
Google Play isn\'t available on this device.
Long-press your watch\'s current face to enter the picker.
Swipe left or right and tap \"Add watch face\" (+).
Scroll and select Concentric from the list.
